flags.reason: The guide gives no accessibility guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

The Page Hero guide (e7ed622) and its evidence were checked on 26 October 2026 on the c8526ae build; the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02 has a different PageHero.tsx (5c1d049 at c8526ae, cfcb2e6 at ace46ca and dbe0e02), changed by Biscuit's ace46ca for Component Bug #405, and the evidence's 28 October note says the guide's copy waits for #405's own publish. Read against the installed source, the token values and the guide page rendered on it (31 October), these sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Sizing's “The hero fills its host’s width and keeps 16 px clear on each side, but adds nothing above or below, so the screen gives it room.” and its title “Full width, 16 px inside”: the root no longer applies PageHero/padding/horizontal (the token is still 16), so the text and the button are as wide as the host; the entry quotes only “The hero fills its host’s width” and “adds nothing above or below, so the screen gives it room”. Sizing's “Figma’s hero has no side padding, and its eyebrow and headline lines are 20 and 29 px.” is left out too: the padding no longer differs from Figma (the line heights still do, the entry's gap from the evidence). (2) Configuration's “set Button / Size S with it, as Figma does”, the PageHero Size S card that sets both modes, and the playground note “PageHero Size S also sets Button / Size S here, as Figma does: the button doesn’t follow PageHero Size on its own.”: PageHero Size S now sets the default button, and the buttons in buttonSlot, to Button / Size S itself, and a Button / Size in modes still wins (buttonModes). (3) States' “Pass media only when you have some: media={false} still leaves an empty box.”: false, '' and null now draw no box (isRenderedSlot). (4) The first Don't caption's “as Storybook’s Default story does”: the stories' meta args set body to '' since ace46ca, so Default shows the price once; the entry quotes only “supportingText and body repeat the price”. (5) Sources: “The package adds 16 px of side padding, its eyebrow and headline lines are taller than Figma’s, PageHero Size S leaves the button at M, and Storybook’s Default story shows the price twice (all reported).”: only the line heights still hold. The evidence's Contract, Web render and Discrepancies lines for the 16 px padding (text 296 wide), “the Button stays M”, “media={false} still draws the empty box.”, “No heading role on the headline; no button disabled or label props.” and the Default story's repeated price are out of date the same way. Not in the guide or the evidence: ace46ca also made the headline a heading (accessibilityRole header, role heading on the web) and added buttonDisabled and buttonAccessibilityLabel for the default button; the entry carries the two props from the package's facts. The guide is updated when Component Bug #405 publishes (the Component Fix flow updates the guide copy a fix changed); #405 stays open only for the eyebrow and headline line heights, which wait for Marcin's call. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r27, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #405.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small eyebrow text shown above the headline. Default "Upgrade to JioFinance+", from the component source.

props.name: showEyebrow

props.description: Main headline text. Centered and bold. Default "Resume earning cashback, extra points, and 1% gold", from the component source.

props.name: supportingText

props.name: body

props.name: showBody

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Label for the default action button. Ignored when `buttonSlot` is provided. Default "Renew for free", from the component source.

props.name: onButtonPress
props.description: Press handler for the default action button. Ignored when `buttonSlot` is provided.

props.name: buttonDisabled
props.description: Disable the default action button. Ignored when `buttonSlot` is provided.

props.name: buttonAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the default action button. Ignored when `buttonSlot` is provided.

props.name: showButton
props.description: Whether to render the default action button. Ignored when `buttonSlot` is provided. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: Optional slot to fully override the action button area (e.g. a `ButtonGroup` with several buttons). When provided, `showButton`, `buttonLabel`, `onButtonPress`, `buttonDisabled`, and `buttonAccessibilityLabel` are ignored. `modes` are automatically cascaded into this slot.

props.name: media
props.description: Optional media element shown above the text block (eyebrow + headline). Intentionally typed as `React.ReactNode` so the consumer can bring any renderer they like — `<Image />`, `<IconCapsule />`, a Lottie player (`LottiePlayer` / `lottie-react-native`), an `<SvgXml />` from `react-native-svg`, a `<Video />` from `react-native-video`, a gradient view, or a custom illustration. The library deliberately does NOT wrap Lottie / video runtimes (they require native modules + pod autolinking on every consumer's app), so PageHero just allocates a token-sized container and lets the slot render whatever it wants. The slot is rendered inside a `width × height` box driven by the `video/width` and `video/height` tokens from the `Video / Output` collection (`L | M | S` → 117 / 70 / 20; default `L` = 117×117). `modes` are automatically cascaded into the slot via `cloneChildrenWithModes`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides applied to the outer container.
